articles.summary: Good Times Restaurants Inc. (Nasdaq: GTIM), operator of Bad Daddy’s Burger Bar and Good Times Burgers Frozen Custard , today announced that on February 5, 2026 it will release financial results for its first fiscal quarter ended December 30, 2025. The Company will host a conference call to discuss its financial results following the release of its earnings announcement and webcast. articles.title: Good Times Restaurants to Release Results on February 5, 2026 for the Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Ended December 30, 2025
